purpose: main is red on the Conservative provenance, licenses & SBOM baseline check because a source file landed without regenerating docs/security/cryptographic-inventory.json. Every open PR inherits the failure and it reads as the PR's own until the base branch is checked. This regenerates the baseline and nothing else.
requiredInvariants: Generated output only. Both files are written by scripts/security/discover-cryptography.mjs and neither is hand-edited; the scanner itself is not touched.

The newly surfaced weak-prng site is NOT changed here. Folding a behaviour fix into a baseline regeneration would hide it a second way, which is the same failure mode the stale baseline already caused.
No production, REG.RU, DNS, database or credential mutation. No schema change, no migration, no dependency, no lockfile change. New mandatory cost: 0 RUB.
acceptance: The failure was confirmed on the base branch before anything was written: on 4de039b82 with nothing applied, discovered 2198 against a committed 2197, and discover-cryptography reported 7 of 8.
Regenerated by running the tool rather than editing the number: scannedFiles 2197 -> 2198 and weak-prng sites 54 -> 55.

The stale baseline was hiding a real new site, and it is named rather than silently absorbed: apps/web/app/platform-v7/register/RegisterFormClientPublic.tsx:67 builds a registration idempotency key as globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.() || `reg-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`. Whether that fallback is acceptable is a separate decision and is left open.
